data.gender_notes: Haleema is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'halim' which means 'gentle' or 'kind'. The name Haleema carries the meaning “Generous, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haleema usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Haleema was the wet-nurse of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
data.etymology: Haleema belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haleema total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

In Islamic tradition, Haleema is revered as a symbol of goodness, faithfulness, and kindness. She is also known as the nurse and caretaker of the Prophet and is considered a model of compassion and devotion. The name Haleema has been used in various cultures and languages, including Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, and Turkish.
